# Aurixa Systems

> Aurixa Systems builds governed AI operating systems for Australian property, finance and advisory firms: client intelligence, financial modelling, voice agents and compliance oversight in one controlled platform.

Aurixa Systems Pty Ltd (ABN 49 695 868 243) is based in New South Wales, Australia.
Website: https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/

Access is granted through a staged Priority Access application rather than
self-serve sign-up, and the Priority Access Application page below is the
entry point. This guide does not cover pricing.

What the platform covers:

- Property intelligence and financial modelling: borrowing capacity and serviceability against lender policy and APRA buffers, 10-year cash flow and yield analysis, scenario modelling and suburb snapshots.
- Client reporting: white-label client briefs and reports, client and finance portals, and CRM integration.
- Operational automation: workflow and deal pipeline management, configurable automations, and AI-assisted voice agents for inbound and outbound calls.
- Compliance OS: AML/CTF and customer due diligence workflows, information governance and role-based access controls, set out on the Compliance page. Each organisation remains responsible for its own regulatory obligations.
- AML/CTF Compliance Passport: a guided client journey through identity verification, documents, screening, ownership, source of funds and review, recorded as a Passport that, where authorised, can be shared with the other professionals in a property transaction.
- Builders Network: builders and developers publish their stock once and connect to the advisory firms placing clients into it, one firm at a time.
- Security and governance: data encrypted at rest and in transit, isolated data per partner tenant, role-based permissions, and client data that is not repurposed for internal machine-learning models.

Who it serves: buyers agents, wealth advisors, property advisory firms, real estate agencies, mortgage and finance businesses, investment groups, developers and enterprise property networks.

## Platform
- [Property Intelligence & Financial Modelling Platform](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/platform): For Australian property and finance firms: borrowing capacity and serviceability, 10-year cash flow modelling, white-label client reports, suburb snapshots and AI voice agents.
- [Solutions for Property Advisory Firms](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/solutions): How property advisory and finance firms use Aurixa to win clients with serviceability modelling, keep strategies within APRA buffers and scale client reporting.
- [Industries: Buyers Agents, Advisory & Finance Firms](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/industries): Aurixa serves buyers agents, wealth advisors, property advisory firms, real estate agencies, mortgage and finance businesses, investment groups, developers and enterprise networks.
- [Platform Module Library](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/resources): Every module in the Aurixa platform: workflow and deal flow, borrowing capacity and cash flow, property and scenario analysis, white-label reports, client portals and governance.

## Compliance
- [Compliance, Security & AML/CTF Governance](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/compliance): How Aurixa supports compliance operations: encrypted infrastructure, AML/CTF and customer due diligence workflows, information governance and clearly shared responsibilities.
- [AML/CTF Compliance Passport](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/compliance-passport): A guided AML/CTF journey for property transactions: identity verification, documents, screening, ownership, source of funds and review, recorded in one Compliance Passport.

## Builders Network
- [Builders Network: Publish Stock to Advisory Firms](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/builders): The Aurixa Builders Network: builders and developers publish stock once and reach the advisory firms placing clients into it, with connections granted one firm at a time.
- [Apply for Builders Network Access](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/builders/apply): Builders, developers and sales representatives apply for access to the Aurixa Builders Network. We set up your organisation and email your access link.

## Documentation
- [Command Center Documentation](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/docs): Command Center documentation: client management, borrowing capacity, portfolio analysis, deal pipeline, agreements, voice and reporting. Full articles unlock with your entitlement.

## Company and access
- [About Us: Built From Inside Property & Finance](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/about): Who built Aurixa Systems and why: property professionals and quantitative engineers, the principles behind the platform, and the data sovereignty framework protecting client data.
- [Priority Access Application](https://www.aurixasystems.com.au/contact): Join the Aurixa Systems waitlist by applying for priority access. Tell us about your organisation and what you most want to improve, and the team will review your application.
